snippet.title: CountDown // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2794640/CountDown/

CountDown is a casual, semi-idle, 2D tower-defense. Waves of enemies are advancing, it's your job to bolster your city, or rather, ammunition, and wipe them out. Will you rise to the challenge, or let your city crumble?

Developed by
@GrowingPaignsStudios
